❤️ J-RED Loop 111 — MEDIUM: one LOCAL-FAKE ACP v1 session/prompt terminal round-trip.

Goal:
After the adopted initialize + session/new support, prove exactly one local fake session/prompt on the SAME child process (initialize #0 -> session/new #1 -> session/prompt #2). Return only the validated prompt stopReason. This is mock-only incremental ACP wiring, NOT real provider readiness or model execution.

Read first:
- current src/relay/acp_client.py (especially _acp_exchange and acp_open_session_wire)
- current src/relay/acp_stdio_transport.py::spawn_stdio_transport (READ ONLY)
- current tests/relay/test_acp_client.py
- official agentclientprotocol/python-sdk pinned commit 9d07d7871ef4b220b8507e15fc4b1560f0950a64: src/acp/client/connection.py::ClientSideConnection.prompt, src/acp/meta.py AGENT_METHODS["session_prompt"]="session/prompt"; examples/client.py TextContentBlock(text=...)
- main docs/RELAY_MINIMAL_REUSE_ROADMAP.md; do not invent an alternative ACP protocol.

Allowed changed paths ONLY:
- src/relay/acp_client.py
- tests/relay/test_acp_client.py

Hard scope / Do Not Touch:
- No new dependency, module, framework, generic RPC engine, event bus or docs.
- Do NOT modify ACP stdio transport, provider profiles/adapters, policy, lifecycle, dispatcher, Admission Gate, readiness/proof, workflows or command bus.
- No real provider binaries or authentication, live provider/model/API, network or socket operations; no billing, secret, permission or settings changes.
- Do not implement notification routing, tool handling, streaming, cancel, provider execution, or full client; scope is one local FAKE child replying directly to session/prompt.
- retry=0; fallback=disabled; no implicit restart or second process; no Merge/rebase/force push/branch deletion.

Existing implementation to reuse:
- Existing spawn_stdio_transport and _acp_exchange; preserve acp_initialize_wire and acp_open_session_wire public behavior.
- Reuse initialize/new request shapes and validation from Loop 109, extracting ONLY a small private helper if necessary to avoid duplicating handshake within the SAME child process.

Required semantics:
1. Add a small async function (e.g. acp_mock_prompt_wire(command,*args,cwd:str,prompt_text:str,timeout:float=2.0)->str). ONE spawn_stdio_transport lifetime for all three numbered JSON-RPC 2.0 NDJSON requests.
2. initialize id=0 protocolVersion=1 and exact prior client capability/info shape, then session/new id=1 with cwd and mcpServers=[]; require valid nonblank sessionId. If either fails, do NOT send session/prompt.
3. session/prompt id=2 params exactly {"sessionId":validated_id,"prompt":[{"type":"text","text":prompt_text}]}. Only local fake static prompt text in tests. Validate matching integer id=2, no error, dict result and a nonblank string stopReason. Return only stopReason. Do not claim to capture streamed content.
4. Finite receives and existing process cleanup on any timeout/EOF/malformed/error; never retry, relaunch or silently accept another response.

Negative / failure cases:
- wrong response id at session/prompt (including bool), missing/invalid result or missing/blank stopReason, explicit error or timeout;
- invalid session/new prevents prompt transmission;
- no duplicate child process; the test fake has one process for all three requests.
- Treat interleaved notifications as unsupported in this bounded mock primitive; do not fake real-adapter conformance. If correct implementation requires generic routing, STOP and report exact limitation instead of widening this task.

Acceptance criteria:
- One focused local sys.executable fake test directly proves exact #0/#1/#2 order, content/cwd/sessionId/stopReason, same child process.
- Focused negative cases directly exercise failure semantics (not vacuous assertions).
- Existing initialize/new tests unchanged in behavior; exact allowed-file diff only.
- This does not authorize any live provider execution.

Exact validation:
PYTHONPATH=src python -m unittest tests.relay.test_acp_client -v
PYTHONPATH=src python -m unittest discover -s tests -t . -v
python -m compileall -q src tests
git diff --check

Publication:
Create only normal isolated Jules PR when all checks pass; never Merge or mutate canonical.

Explicit stop:
Stop/report if additional files/dependencies, real provider execution, permission or architecture decisions are required; if the pinned upstream spec conflicts with these semantics; or if the expected work-branch HEAD/tree does not match. No scope expansion or speculative hardening.
